rows.label: qst640409_msg0001
rows.name:
Oh! It really feels like a secret hot
spring.

rows.label: qst640409_msg0002
rows.name:
It's run-down... It hasn't been
maintained at all.

rows.label: qst640409_msg0003
rows.name:
You could use a place like this as
much as you want even without a pass.

rows.label: qst640409_msg0004
rows.name:
Come on. We came all this way, so
let's get in.

rows.label: qst640409_msg0006
rows.name:
Today we'll all have a fun tea party
while soaking in the hot spring!

rows.label: qst640409_msg0101
rows.name:
Meleph-sama, this is a famous spring.
It makes your skin so smooth.

rows.label: qst640409_msg0102
rows.name:
Yeah... I've been in Superbia a long
time, but this is my first time
bathing here.

rows.label: qst640409_msg0103
rows.name:
Seori, if anyone comes to peek, don't
show mercy.

rows.label: qst640409_msg0104
rows.name: I'll cut them down without fail...

rows.label: qst640409_msg0105
rows.name:
It's okay. Kaku-tan and Suke-tan are
keeping proper watch!

rows.label: qst640409_msg0106
rows.name:
Having a tea party while soaking in
the hot spring is fun!

rows.label: qst640409_msg0107
rows.name: It is. I feel so happy...

rows.label: qst640409_msg0108
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]The animals are in the way! I can't
see my beloved friend!!!
